title: KinderCare Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
summary: Second Quarter Highlighted by Continued Progress Across Key Growth Initiatives and Center Footprint Optimization. Company Updates Full-Year Outlook. KinderCare Learning Companies, Inc. (NYSE: KLC) (“KinderCare,” the “Company,” and “we”), a leading provider of high-quality early childhood education, today announced financial results for the second quarter ended July 4, 2026.
